stories.summary: The UN's annual climate change summit, known as COP31, opens this Monday in Turkey amid deep concern following deadly heatwaves in Europe and deadly floods in Nepal. articles.summary: We made it through the Bluenami without a national catastrophe, thank God. But had there been one, there would have been dozens of social media-savvy preppers ready for it. For weeks, and especially in recent days, media apps showed off bare shelves where toilet paper and bottles of water used to be. What caused the urgent preparation for a sustained power outage? As best as I can tell, it was the revelation of real, evidence-based, ongoing vulnerabilities colliding with insane, hysterical fearmongering from online personalities.
